title: Blade Beach '90
about: BLADE BEACH '90: a rollerblade warrior skates the boardwalk at sunset, 1990. Written in Sprout. Jump, grind, kick, and take on the roller-derby giant.
line: A 1990 rollerblade warrior on SPROUT·8: jump hydrants and gaps, grind rails and kick masked gang skaters along the beach, the pier and the neon strip, then take on the roller-derby giant.
